h1.en: What Power Cell Electric 60 Concrete Pump Prints lists, with Horsepower as the illustration
h1.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么列出的内容，用「馬力」做插图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 60 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 90 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是90 kW。画面「End-face mechanical seal」的主体是US Patent 2951719。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower: Imperial Horsepower. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 60 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 90 kW. The frame “End-face mechanical seal” shows US Patent 2951719. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 35 MPa. Hopper capacity is 0.7 m³. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower页上的Imperial Horsepower。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是90 kW。河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 画面「End-face mechanical seal」的主体是US Patent 2951719。细石输送（水平/垂直） 200 m / 600 m。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Motor Power is 90 kW. Theoretical Output remains 40 m³/h. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 112.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 112。

question.en: What power text does Electric 60 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Motor Power is 90 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower.
answer.zh: 电机功率是90 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 40 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 35 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是40 m³/h。最大出口压力是35 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower画面里印出的数字。
